items.label: LEMMA
items.statement: Amounts are rounded half-to-even to the currency's minor unit.
items.mechanism: round() rounds exact binary ties to the even neighbour at a fixed 2 decimals (renamed from roundHalfEven() in 2.0)
items.gap: Not currency-aware: decimals defaults to 2 and convert() never passes a minor unit, so 0-decimal (JPY) and 3-decimal (KWD) currencies are rounded wrongly. Ties are detected on the float product, so decimal ties that are not exact in binary go the wrong way (e.g. round(0.545) = 0.55, round(1.015) = 1.01; 573 of 10,000 ties in 0.005..99.995 differ from decimal half-even). Tests only use binary-exact ties (0.125, 0.375).

items.label: LEMMA
items.statement: FX rates are cached for 60 seconds, so checkout never waits on the rate API twice.
items.gap: The cache was removed in 2.0.0 (CHANGELOG: stale rates caused mispriced carts). src/fx-cache.js, cachedRate() and tests/fx-cache.test.js no longer exist; convert() fetches the rate on every call, so checkout waits on the rate API every time. The statement is now false, not just unverified.

items.label: LEMMA
items.statement: If the rate API is down, the last published reference rates are used.
items.mechanism: rateWithFallback() returns REFERENCE_RATES[pair] when the fetch throws
items.gap: REFERENCE_RATES is a hard-coded two-pair table (EUR/USD, USD/BRL), not a 'last published' feed; any other pair returns undefined and convert() yields NaN. Only a throwing fetch counts as 'down'; a hanging fetch has no timeout. Test covers EUR/USD only.
